summary: Frontend-only verification of TWO targeted changes in WorldMapSection on Home: (A) Morocco + Western Sahara merged into a SINGLE outline (no internal white dividing line), and (B) 6 dashed connection routes converging on Morocco from EVERY continent (North America, South America, Europe, Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, Oceania). Verified at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: WorldMapSection.jsx: topojson 'merge' on geometries 504 (Morocco) + 732 (W. Sahara) produces a single closed outline (verified moroccoPath d attribute starts with one 'M' subpath -> mCount=1 on both desktop and mobile, i.e. no internal divider).

Routes generation iterates 6 ORIGINS and produces 6 Q-curve dashed paths converging on projection([-6,31.5]); each route has matching origin nodes (outer r=3.4 ring + filled r=1.8 dot) and a single cream convergence marker (r=6.5 ring + r=2.6 fill) on Morocco. Verified counts at runtime: 6/6/1.
Minor (carry-over from iter 60, still applies): topojson fetch has no abort/retry; offline reload leaves 'Trazando el mapa…' loader forever. Low priority.
Minor: route origin coordinates are hardcoded; if the team ever localises labels for these continents, consider centralising them in a constants module for reuse with the regional Morocco map.
